question.text: The number of reflexive relations on a set $A$ of $n$ elements is equal to

solution.text:
Total number of ordered pair $=\mathrm{n}^2$
Number of pair that can be included or excluded $=n^2-n$
Each of the remaining $\mathrm{n}^2-\mathrm{n}$ pairs we have two choices
Include it in the relation or not include it
So total no. of reflexive relation is $2^{n(n-1)}$
